Features.title: Features
Features.text1: Customer information such as phone numbers and emails is automatically saved in their profiles.
Features.text2: Don't worry about losing access to Instagram. Customer information will be transferred to your dedicated database, so even if your page is removed, you'll still have access to your customers.
Features.text3: Don't worry about losing customer messages, payment receipts, or orders. Customers can place orders easily without needing to register.
Features.text4: After placing an order, purchase information is automatically sent to the post office, and a shipping receipt is issued.
Features.title5: New Version of Smart Direct Messaging
Features.text5: Respond to customers smarter and create message automation to boost sales.
Features.text6: Engage with customers through multiple channels like direct messages, automation, SMS, and more.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.paragraph1: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard the information you provide when you use our services to manage your Instagram direct messages and comments. By using our website and services, you agree to the terms outlined in this policy.

informationWeCollect.title: Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.paragraph1: We may collect the following types of information when you use our services:
informationWeCollect.point1Text: This includes your name, email address, and other information you provide when you register or contact us.
informationWeCollect.point2Text: To provide our services, we may access information from your Instagram account, such as your direct messages, comments, and profile details. We only collect the data necessary to fulfill the service requirements.
informationWeCollect.point3Text: Information such as your IP address, browser type, and usage patterns may also be collected for analytical purposes to improve our services.

howWeUseYourInformation.title: How We Use Your Information
howWeUseYourInformation.paragraph1: We use the collected information for the following purposes:
howWeUseYourInformation.point1Text: To provide and improve our services.
howWeUseYourInformation.point2Text: To personalize your experience by tailoring our services based on your preferences.
howWeUseYourInformation.point3Text: To communicate with you regarding updates, support, and promotional offers.
howWeUseYourInformation.point4Text: To ensure compliance with Instagram's policies and protect against unauthorized use.

sharingYourInformation.title: Sharing Your Information
sharingYourInformation.paragraph1: We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes. We may share your information in the following circumstances:
sharingYourInformation.point1Text: We may share data with trusted service providers who assist us in delivering our services.
sharingYourInformation.point2Text: We may disclose your information to comply with applicable laws, regulations, or legal processes.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.paragraph1: We are committed to securing your data and have implemented appropriate technical and organizational measures to prevent unauthorized access, use, or disclosure of your personal information.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.point1Text: Access the personal information we hold about you.
yourRights.point2Text: Request corrections or updates to your information.
yourRights.point3Text: Request deletion of your data, subject to applicable legal requirements.

changesToThisPrivacyPolicy.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changesToThisPrivacyPolicy.paragraph1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page, and we encourage you to review it periodically.

contactUs.title: Contact Us
contactUs.paragraph1: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at: support@pediland.com.

faq.q1: Can I upgrade my subscription after payment?
faq.a1: Yes, you can upgrade your subscription at any time, and if upgraded, half the remaining time of your current subscription will be added to the higher plan.
faq.q2: Will scheduled content be published if the subscription is not renewed?
faq.a2: When your subscription expires, your account's activities will stop, and Novinhub features will be deactivated for you.
faq.q3: Why are WhatsApp and some social networks not available?
faq.a3: Due to API limitations or the absence of channels and pages in all social networks, it's not possible to add them all.
faq.q4: Does unused subscription time get preserved?
faq.a4: No, after activation and the start of your subscription, the time decreases automatically regardless of usage.
